headline: Strengthened by the central bank, the country's banking sector is returning to good governance - MZamin
summary: Bangladesh's banking sector is returning to good governance, strengthened by the central bank, after years of alleged plunder and institutional occupation under the previous government. The reconstruction of the financial sector is described as the key challenge.
why: Bangladesh's banking sector underpins credit to its economy, and central bank oversight affects lender stability and foreign investor confidence.
